svg.title: Explainable Fake Review Detection — pipeline visualization
svg.desc: Artistic engineering visualization of the machine-learning pipeline: 8,000 reviews (50% fake, 50% genuine) flow through four feature categories (TF-IDF, Sentence-BERT embeddings, sentiment analysis, handcrafted linguistic attributes) into a three-model stacking ensemble (Logistic Regression, XGBoost, LightGBM), then to a trust score and explainable feature impact in a Streamlit dashboard. Results: 94.42% accuracy, 94.58% F1 score, 8,000 reviews, 3 models.
